project.name: Orbit Parcel
project.purpose: A short spatial-sorting puzzle with a satisfying completion screen.
project.audience: Teenagers and adults playing a quick browser game.

game.core_loop: Select a parcel, rotate a route and send it to the matching airlock; observe feedback and plan the next move.
game.end_conditions: Complete when all parcels arrive. Let the player retry mistakes and restart the board.

art.direction: Clean flat space-station diagrams, clear silhouettes and restrained orbital motion.
art.sound: Short original procedural confirmation tones with a mute control.

constraints: Differentiate destinations with shape labels as well as colour.
Keep all assets inside the HTML file.
No accounts, email, analytics or network requirement.
